schema_basis: Native type registration + field offsets + metadata ProtoMember custom-attribute constructor arguments

CheckHackBehavior.effect: On errorCode0, inspects hack_warning list; empty/invalid path clears isHacker and runs CheckPlayerRepairClientSuccess. Nonempty path sets isHacker and copies first warning title/content/countdown to local warning model. Not a universal anti-cheat verdict.

GetCreditScoreInfo.effect: On errorCode0, casts/caches response in m_CreditScoreInfo, copies credit_score to CurCreditScore, processes credit_punish_other_info, dispatches model update flag16.

GetReportAndPenalty.effect: On errorCode0, copies report/penalty/compensation lists into UIModelCredit fields, calls InjectReportFeedbackToGameAssist and dispatches model update flag32. Lists include reports and compensation about other accounts, not merely current-account bans.

GetMatchmakingBlacklist.effect: Has cache/count-only/force-request branches. Successful response path reads blacklist and blacklist_info and rebuilds local match-blacklist model. Neighbor APIs add/remove selected blacklisted player IDs; not proof the current account is in an anti-cheat punishment pool.

contract.name: <RequestMatchBlackList>b__0
contract.owner: UIModelMatch closure; exact nested owner not resolved here

captured_credit_score.scope: Captured response only; account identifier redacted; absent fields not inferred as explicit server verdicts.

limitations: Static native fallback bodies may be redirected by active IFix patches.
No server implementation, traffic rewriting, anti-cheat bypass or account-state alteration tested.
Field offset is an in-memory offset, not a wire tag; tags are independently read from attributes.
Outer HTTP encryption/compression/authentication is not fully reconstructed here.
Nested enum namespace aliases and AccountInfoBasicBundleRes are referenced, not fully exported in this schema subset.
